name: React Summit US 2026
description: React Summit US 2026 takes place on November 17 at Liberty Science Center and virtually, followed by a fully virtual conference day on November 20. Workshops are offered separately during the month.

location.name: Liberty Science Center
location.description: Physical attendance is on November 17 only. November 20 is virtual only. The November 17–20 range does not assert conference activity on November 18 or 19.
Virtual access details are provided through the event and ticketing pages.

offers.name: React Summit US, Regular
offers.description: Physical admission on November 17 and remote admission on November 20.

offers.name: Remote React Summit, Early Bird
offers.description: Remote admission on November 17 and November 20.
